metadata.name: e21-channel-address-validation-dark-current
metadata.description: Capture invalid email editing for an existing disposable owner destination in dark appearance; verify saved state remains unchanged and never submit.
Exercise selected E21 invalid address validation in dark appearance on a leased example destination without saving or triggering external effects.

metadata.label: Open the leased fixture with the saved example email destination
Wait for the fixture owner device
Open the selected saved example destination for review
Enter a synthetic incomplete draft without submitting

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.documentElement;root.setAttribute('data-theme','dark');root.setAttribute('data-resolved-theme','dark');for(const key of ['top','right','bottom','left'])root.style.setProperty('--safe-area-inset-'+key,'0px');const insets=Object.fromEntries(['top','right','bottom','left'].map(key=>[key,getComputedStyle(root).getPropertyValue('--safe-area-inset-'+key).trim()]));if(innerWidth!==390||innerHeight!==844||Object.values(insets).some(value=>value!=='0px')||root.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')!=='dark')throw new Error('selected viewport/theme/inset mismatch '+JSON.stringify({width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,insets,theme:root.getAttribute('data-resolved-theme')}));return {viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight},theme:'dark',insets}})()

metadata.label: Assert exact selected viewport, dark appearance, and zero browser insets

evaluate.expression: (()=>{const root=document.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-channel-editor]');const input=root?.querySelector('input[type=email]');const error=root?.querySelector('[data-rcl-form-field-error]');const unchanged=root?.querySelector('[data-testid=reach-invalid-email-preserves-saved]');const review=[...(root?.querySelectorAll('button')||[])].find(button=>button.textContent?.includes('Review changes'));if(input?.value!=='review@'||input.getAttribute('aria-invalid')!=='true'||!error||!unchanged||!review?.hasAttribute('disabled'))throw new Error('expected accessible validation with unchanged saved state '+JSON.stringify({value:input?.value,invalid:input?.getAttribute('aria-invalid'),error:error?.textContent,unchanged:unchanged?.textContent,reviewDisabled:review?.hasAttribute('disabled')}));return {syntheticAddress:input.value,invalid:true,savedAddressUnchanged:true,approvalsUnchanged:true,saveUnavailable:true}})()

metadata.label: Confirm the invalid draft leaves the saved address and approvals unchanged and saving unavailable
